title: Chipotle
blurb: Chipotle Mexican Grill offers fast casual dining with a focus on burritos and bowls. They have numerous locations across many states in the US. Guests can order online or visit a location for dine-in or takeout.
extraNote: Same plaza as McDonalds and Albertson's, next to Verizon at 2300 Harbor Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA
